scientific_integrity: A reproducible exact-integer and rational checker is included. Infinite-rank and stability conclusions rely on displayed polynomial inequalities, not extrapolation from computations.
scientific_limitations: The conclusions apply only to the canonical 72-point E6 root configuration. Novelty is assessed by bounded literature comparison; historical equivalent formulations remain possible. The exhaustive finite root identities and analytic all-degree bounds are provided. No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
title: All-degree spherical-harmonic sampling spectrum and sharp stability on the 72 E6 roots
